slides.texte_overlay:
How to reset your life in the
next 6 months

For Your Mornings:
1. Same wake-up time, 7 days a week.
2. No phone for the first 30 minutes.
3. Make your bed before anything else.
4. Get daylight in the first hour.
5. Write your 3 priorities on paper.

For Your Circle:
1. Call one old friend every week.
2. Spend time with people who build.
3. Leave the group chats that drain you.
4. Make one new friend outside work.
5. Be the one who plans the meetup.

For Your Skills:
1. Pick one skill to learn properly.
2. Practice it 20 minutes a day.
3. Learn one new idea daily.
4. Teach what you learn to a friend.
5. Finish one course or book a month.

For Your Free Time:
1. One hobby with your hands.
2. One long walk every weekend.
3. One trip somewhere new.
4. Less scrolling, more doing.
5. Protect one evening a week for you.
